catalog.applies_to: Aleph Alpha as the creator of the Pharia model families it trains and announces.

notes: Human origin approval only. It records where Aleph Alpha publishes primary release information; it adds no creator, family, release, product or deployment to the dataset, and it does not make Aleph Alpha a pilot creator.
huggingface.co is an already-trusted generic host reached at https://huggingface.co/Aleph-Alpha for the Pharia model cards; it is not re-approved here.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Aleph Alpha's official English blog; authoritative for its model release announcements and the release dates they carry. Bounded to /en/blog, the section checked.
source_catalog.verification: Fetched 2026-08-30: the Pharia-1-LLM announcement at /en/blog/introducing-pharia-1-llm-transparent-and-compliant/ returned HTTP 200 with the visible top-of-page date 26/08/2024 and the heading 'Introducing Pharia-1-LLM: transparent and compliant', on the Aleph-Alpha-owned aleph-alpha.com host. It announces the Pharia-1-LLM-7B-control and -aligned model family under the Open Aleph License.

deferred_origins.decision: already-trusted generic host, not re-approved here
deferred_origins.reason: Reached 2026-08-30 for the Pharia-1-LLM-7B-control model card (HTTP 200). huggingface.co is already a trusted origin through existing dataset sources, so it is noted rather than re-approved; the release date this batch relied on comes from the aleph-alpha.com blog above, not from the card.

ambiguities.topic: Open Aleph License is not an OSI-approved licence
ambiguities.note: Pharia-1-LLM-7B-control is published under the Open Aleph License, which the blog states 'explicitly allows for non-commercial research and educational use'.
ambiguities.guidance: Record the weights as downloadable and open-weight but osiApproved false, and cite the OSI licence index for the non-approval. Do not read the 'Open' in the licence name as OSI approval.
